course.title: BSc Physics (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester
quotes: Duration: 3 years Year of entry: 2027 UCAS course code: F300 / Institution code: M20
A-level A*A*A, including A* in Physics and A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
International Baccalaureate 38 points overall with 7,7,6 at Higher Level, including 7 in both Physics and Mathematics.
•IELTS Academic or IELTS UKVI 6.0 overall with no sub-skill below 5.5, or;
Tuition fees for home students will be £10,050 for the 2027/28 academic year.

Tuition fees for international students will be £40,300 for the 2027/28 academic year. For subsequent academic years, the University reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year
